g.text: CE: adaptive rules and registered sensitivities
Lines: full-32 failure-inclusive medians; bands: IQR. Sensitivities are not selected using outcomes.
Post hoc order is a group diagnostic, chosen using absolute gap; plotted values are relative gaps. All arm × N cells: 0/32 failures.
